operations.after: "This tiny golden aura is the grace of the Erdtree."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "O Radagon, leal hound of the Golden Order."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "I declare mine intent, to search the depths of the Golden Order."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "Hark, brave warriors. Hark, my lord Godfrey. We commend your deeds."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "My Lord, and thy warriors. I divest each of thee of thy grace."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "Then, after thy death, I will give back what I once claimed."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "The Erdtree governs all. The choice is thine."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "There is something I'd like to say."

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "If you intend to claim the frenzied flame,"

operations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
operations.after: "Please, put a stop to this madness."
